Bài tập Multi-word Verbs
 Bài 1: Hoàn thành câu với động từ thích hợp trong ngoặc
(find out / note down / carry on with / get on with / run out of)
1️ We __________ milk. Can you go to the shop?
 2️ She __________ her notes before the meeting.
 3️ They __________ the project although it was difficult.
 4️ I want to __________ what time the meeting starts.
 5️Tom doesn’t __________ his new manager.
✅ Đáp án: 1 ran out of 2 noted down 3 carried on with 4 find out 5 get on with
 Bài 2: Dịch sang tiếng Anh
1️ Tôi đã ghi lại tất cả thông tin trong sổ.
 2️ Chúng tôi hết tiền rồi.
 3️ Anh ấy hòa thuận với tất cả đồng nghiệp.
 4️ Cô ấy tiếp tục làm việc dù rất mệt.
 5️ Tôi muốn tìm ra lý do của vấn đề.
✅ dịch:
1.  	I noted down all the information in my notebook.
2.  	We ran out of money.
3.  	He gets on well with all his colleagues.
4.  	She carried on with her work even though she was tired.
5.  	I want to find out the reason for the problem.
🟦 Bài 3: Multiple Choice
Chọn đáp án đúng nhất để hoàn thành câu:
1️ I don’t earn much, but I can ________ .
 A. carry on B. get by C. find out
 ✅ → B
2️ Please ________ the important dates in your diary.
 A. note down B. run out of C. take up
 ✅ → A
3️ We have ________ paper in the printer!
 A. found out B. got on C. run out of
 ✅ → C
4️ The students didn’t stop; they ________ with the test.
 A. carried on B. ran out C. got on
 ✅ → A
Bài tập Comparatives & Superlatives
 Bài 1: Điền dạng đúng của từ trong ngoặc
1️ This company is __________ (big) than ours.
 2️ My job is __________ (interesting) than yours.
 3️ She is the __________ (careful) person in the team.
 4️Today is __________ (bad) than yesterday.
 5️ He is __________ (successful) manager I know.
✅ Đáp án:
 1 bigger 2 more interesting 3 most careful 4 worse 5 the most successful
 Bài 2: Viết lại câu bằng cấu trúc so sánh đúng
1️ This office is large. That one is small.
 → This office is __________ than that one.
2️ Mary works hard. Peter works harder.
 → Mary doesn’t work __________ Peter.
3️ My job is interesting. Your job is interesting too.
 → My job is __________ your job.
✅ Đáp án:
 1 larger 2 as hard as 3 as interesting as
🟦 Bài 3: Chọn đáp án đúng
1️ My manager is ________ than yours.
 A. more friendly B. friendlier C. the friendliest
 ✅ → B
2️ This year’s profit is ________ than last year’s.
 A. good B. better C. best
 ✅ → B
3️ She is ________ person in the company.
 A. more intelligent B. the most intelligent C. most intelligent
 ✅ → B
 Bài 4: Dịch sang tiếng Anh
1️ Công ty này lớn hơn công ty cũ của tôi.
 → ........................................................................
2️ Đây là người quản lý tốt nhất mà tôi từng gặp.
 → ........................................................................
3️ Ngành công nghiệp phần mềm đang phát triển nhanh hơn bao giờ hết.
 → ........................................................................
✅ Gợi ý:
1.  	This company is bigger than my old one.
2.  	This is the best manager I’ve ever met.
3.  	The software industry is growing faster than ever.

PRE-WRITING ACTIVITIES (Warm-up & Practice)
 Task 1 – Complete the sentences (Past & Present tense review)
Điền thì đúng của động từ trong ngoặc.
1️ Google ________ (start) in 1998.
 2️ Larry Page and Sergey Brin ________ (be) students at Stanford University.
 3️ Today, Google ________ (employ) more than 100,000 people.
 4️ They ________ (create) the first search engine when they were students.
 5️ Google ________ (be) one of the most successful companies in the world.
✅ Đáp án: started – were – employs – created – is
 Task 2 – Combine the sentences using when
Ví dụ:
 ️ He finished university. He started his own business.
 → He started his own business when he finished university.
1️ She got her first job. She was only 18.
 2️ They opened the first store. They were in London.
 3️ He became a manager. He was 25 years old.
 4️ The company expanded. It was 2010.
Gợi ý đáp án:
1.  	She got her first job when she was only 18.
2.  	They opened the first store when they were in London.
3.  	He became a manager when he was 25 years old.
4.  	The company expanded when it was 2010.
 Task 3 – Add detail (Writing support)
Thêm chi tiết để câu trở nên thú vị hơn.
 (Add time, reason, place, or results.)
Ví dụ:
 ️ Steve Jobs started Apple.
 → Steve Jobs started Apple in his garage in California when he was young.
1️ The company became successful.
 2️ She started her own business.
 3️ They worked hard.
 4️ He opened the first shop.
✅ Gợi ý mở rộng:
1.  	The company became successful after only two years.
2.  	She started her own business when she finished university.
3.  	They worked hard to make their dream come true.
4.  	He opened the first shop in his hometown in 2012.

️ Exercise 1 – Choose the correct word
1️ ____ brother works in a hospital. (My / I)
 2️That’s ____ car. It’s very old. (our / us)
 3️ Is this ____ pen? (you / your)
 4️ They love ____ new school. (their / them)
 5️ The dog is eating ____ food. (its / it)
✅ Answer key: 1 My 2 our 3 your 4 their 5 its
 2. Subject and Object Pronouns
📘 We use subject pronouns (I, you, he, she, it, we, they) and object pronouns (me, you, him, her, it, us, them).
🧠 Example:
·         He is my friend. I like him.
·         They help us every day.
️ Exercise 2 – Complete with subject or object pronouns
1️ This is Anna. Do you know ____?
 2️ Peter is nice. I like ____ a lot.
 3️ John and I are friends. Come with ____!
 4️ ____ are my teachers. I see ____ every day.
 5️ Where is my book? I can’t find ____!
✅ Answer key: 1 her 2 him 3 us 4 They / them 5 it
😲 3. -ED and -ING Adjectives
📘 Use -ed to describe how someone feels. Use -ing to describe the thing or situation.
🧠 Example:
·         The movie is boring.
·         I’m bored with the movie.
️ Exercise 3 – Choose the correct adjective
1️ The test was really ________ (tired / tiring).
 2️ I’m ________ (bored / boring) because there’s nothing to do.
 3️ That was a very ________ (excited / exciting) game!
 4️ She felt ________ (shocked / shocking) when she heard the news.
 5️ His story was so ________ (fascinated / fascinating).
✅ Answer key: 1 tiring 2 bored 3 exciting 4 shocked 5 fascinating
⚙️ 4. Describing Objects
 We use these structures:
·         is used for + V-ing → The ruler is used for measuring length.
·         is made of + noun → The bag is made of leather.
·         is used to + verb → It is used to play music.
·         has ... parts → It has three main parts.
️ Exercise 4 – Fill in the blanks
1️ A broom ________ (is used for / is used to) sweeping the floor.
 2️ A spoon ________ (is made of / is made from) metal.
 3️ This machine ________ (is used for / lets you) make coffee.
 4️ The ruler ________ measuring straight lines.
 5️The radio ________ two main parts: the speaker and the tuner.
✅ Answer key:
 1 is used for 2 is made of 3 lets you 4 is used for 5 has
Exercise 2: Complete the sentences
Use the words: kind – intelligent – calm – honest – patient
1️My teacher is very ________. She never gets angry easily.
 2️ My dad is ________. He always helps other people.
 3️ My sister is ________. She tells the truth all the time.
 4️ My friend is really ________. He can solve problems quickly.
 5️ The doctor is very ________. She listens carefully to every patient.
✅ Answer key: 1 calm 2 kind 3 honest 4 intelligent 5 patient
 
🟨 Step 2 – Guided Writing (Practice sentences)
️ Exercise 3: Make sentences using the prompts
Example given:
·         admire / mother / hardworking → I admire my mother because she is hardworking.
1️ admire / teacher / kind
 → ___________________________________________
2️ respect / father / honest and patient

3️ admire / friend / talented singer

✅ Sample answers:
1.      I admire my teacher because she is kind.
2.      I respect my father because he is honest and patient.
3.      I admire my friend because she is a talented singer.

tiếp với unit 10
1. Conditionals (Câu điều kiện loại 1 và loại 2)
a. Cấu trúc chính:
Loại
Cấu trúc
Nghĩa
Type 1 (Real / Possible)
If + present simple, will / can + V
Nói về điều có thể xảy ra trong tương lai.
Type 2 (Unreal / Hypothetical)
If + past simple, would / could + V
Nói về điều không có thật hoặc tưởng tượng.

🪐 Ví dụ:
·         If we find water on Mars, scientists will study it. (có thể thật)
·         If aliens landed on Earth, people would be shocked. (giả định thôi)
b. Bài tập 1 – Match the halves
 (Chọn A hoặc B để hoàn thành câu)
1️ If scientists find life on Mars,
 2️ If I were an astronaut,
 3️ If we study astronomy,
 4️ If there were more space research,
a. people would understand the universe better.
 b. I would love to explore other planets.
 c. we will learn about stars and galaxies.
 d. they will tell the world.
✅ Key: 1–d, 2–b, 3–c, 4–a
c. Bài tập 2 – Complete the sentences:
 Điền động từ đúng dạng:
 1️ If we ______ (send) robots to the Moon, they ______ (collect) data.
 2️ If I ______ (see) an alien, I ______ (take) a photo!
 3️ If there ______ (be) no Sun, life ______ (not / exist).
 4️ If I ______ (travel) to space, I ______ (feel) excited.
✅ Key: 1 send / will collect 2 saw / would take 3 were / would not exist 4 travelled / would feel
🔹 2. Infinitive of Purpose (Động từ nguyên mẫu chỉ mục đích)
Cấu trúc:
 👉 to + V (infinitive)
 Dùng để diễn tả “mục đích” – lý do làm việc gì.
🪐 Ví dụ:
·         NASA sent robots to explore Mars.
·         Astronauts exercise every day to stay healthy.

Bài tập:
 Hoàn thành câu với to + V:
1️ Scientists build rockets ______ study the universe.
 2️ Astronauts wear suits ______ protect themselves.
 3️ We use telescopes ______ see distant stars.
 4️ They travel to space ______ do research.
✅ Key: to study / to protect / to see / to do
🔹 3. Developing Sentence Structure (Mở rộng câu phức)
Dùng cụm để mở đầu câu, giúp bài viết học thuật hơn:
Mẫu
Nghĩa
Ví dụ
Some people think that…
Một số người nghĩ rằng…
Some people think that aliens exist.
Scientists believe that…
Các nhà khoa học tin rằng…
Scientists believe that Mars had water.
Studies show that…
Các nghiên cứu cho thấy rằng…
Studies show that the Moon is moving away.

Bài tập: Viết lại câu bằng cách thêm cụm mở đầu:
1️ There may be life on other planets. → ________________________
 2️ The Earth is getting hotter. → ________________________
 3️ Humans will live on Mars one day. → ________________________
✅ Gợi ý: Scientists believe that / Studies show that / Some people think that

🔹 4. Should & It is important to (Cấu trúc dùng trong writing)
a. Cấu trúc:
Dạng
Ví dụ
Should + V
We should spend more money on space research.
It is important to + V
It is important to protect our planet.
Should not + V
We should not pollute the atmosphere.

 
b. Bài tập:
 Viết lại câu dùng should hoặc it is important to
1️ (study astronomy) → _____________________________
 2️ (not forget about the Earth) → _____________________________
 3️ (save money for space research) → _____________________________
 4️ (protect our atmosphere) → _____________________________
✅ Key
1.      We should study astronomy.
2.      We should not forget about the Earth.
3.      It is important to save money for space research.
4.      It is important to protect our atmosphere.

Part 1 – Developing Sentence Structure
Bài tập 1. Put the words in order to make sentences.
1️ houses / there will be / by 2050 / on the moon / Scientists believe that /.
 2️ Reports show that / is / Pluto / not a planet /.
 3️ Some people think that / TV programmes / are / a good way to learn about science /.
 4️ Scientists believe that / we / need / to study / whether people can live in space /.
 5️ Studies suggest that / could exist / life / on other planets /.
✅ Đáp án:
Scientists believe that there will be houses on the moon by 2050.
Reports show that Pluto is not a planet.
Some people think that TV programmes are a good way to learn about science.
Scientists believe that we need to study whether people can live in space.
Studies suggest that life could exist on other planets.
🧩 Part 2 – Sentence Building Practice
Bài tập 2. Complete the sentences using your own ideas.
1️ Some people think that _____________________________.
 2️Scientists believe that _____________________________.
 3️ Reports show that _____________________________.
 4️ Studies suggest that _____________________________.
🧩 Part 3 – Grammar for Writing: Should & It is important to
Bài tập 3. Complete the sentences using should or it is important to.
1️ We __________ study space to understand our universe.
 2️ __________ protect the Earth before exploring other planets.
 3️ Governments __________ not spend too much money on space projects.
 4️ __________ support scientists in their space research.
✅ Đáp án:
should
It is important to
should
